name: Todo 360
description: Todo 360, known as Todo for short, was a techno-service droid in the employ of the Duros bounty hunter Cad Bane. He helped Bane steal a holocron from the Jedi Temple with the help of Cato Parasitti, a female bounty hunter. He was destroyed in a ventilation shaft that lead to the communications room of the temple as a decoy for his master to get the holocron. Todo was later rebuilt by Anakin Skywalker, escaped, and rejoined Bane. He assisted Bane in capturing C-3PO and R2-D2 to extract data concerning the Senate Building's floor plans.
